display.title: CurrencyBeacon exchange-rate API
display.summary: Query latest, historical, conversion, time-series, and supported-currency data with caller-owned CurrencyBeacon credentials.

documentation.stabilityNote: Independently curated CurrencyBeacon v1 read-only REST contract covering the supplier's published latest, historical, convert, timeseries, and currencies endpoints. Callers connect directly with their own credentials; Hub does not proxy, cache, persist, or display supplier responses.

pricing.summary: CurrencyBeacon offers free and paid plans; available data and quotas depend on the caller's current plan.

credentials.description: CurrencyBeacon API key supplied by the caller; it must not be placed in request examples or persisted.
